text: 随着上市公司三季报披露逐步推进，A股市场正处在情绪修复与盈利验证交织的阶段。日前，中信建投证券首席策略分析师夏凡捷指出，当前市场调整主要是内外部因素共振下的估值与交易结构调整，而非基本面系统性恶化，三季报中AI算力链、资源品、高端制造出海三大方向的业绩亮点，正为市场注入信心。（每经网）
text_en: As listed companies gradually disclose their third-quarter reports, the A-share market is in a phase where sentiment repair and earnings verification are intertwined. Recently, Xia Fanjie, Chief Strategy Analyst at CSC Financial, pointed out that the current market adjustment is mainly a valuation and trading structure adjustment under the resonance of internal and external factors, rather than a systemic deterioration in fundamentals. The performance highlights in the third-quarter reports in three major directions—the AI computing power chain, resource products, and high-end manufacturing going global—are injecting confidence into the market. (National Business Daily)
